history.prompt: Cinematic film still, anamorphic 35mm look. A wide establishing composition of a logistics yard at dawn. Rows of identical, unbranded heavy-duty truck cabs are parked in perfect alignment, receding into deep atmospheric haze. A single strong practical light source casts long shadows. Restrained teal-and-amber palette. Motion is implied by an empty loading bay in the foreground, with no people facing the camera.
